speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether she can provide an update on the progress that the Public Service has made in eliminating single-use items from their catering events; and (b) what is the timeline for completely eliminating single-use items from all Public Service catering events.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Apart from these measures, we also recognise that public sector events are key touchpoints and bringing reusables or eliminating single-use items from catering events are important markers for behaviour change.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The list of practices includes requesting participants to bring their own reusable cups, cutlery and containers, and to provide recycling bins if bottled water must be provided.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just check whether we have a target date where we will completely eliminate the use of disposables at our events or at our meetings?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, could I also ask whether we are actually tracking the exact number of disposables that are being used at events organised for or by the Public Service, and also, at our meetings?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And I ask this, hopefully, with some sense of urgency, because last week, I was at a Ministry's office for an event and disposable cups were still being used.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And I think, as we preach so much about going zero-waste, we really should practise what we preach.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: So, we will take a holistic approach, a measured approach in our push for change and contextualise ideas that are suited to our local waste management system.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: If the Member can share with me, offline, which event he went to that offered those cups, we can nudge our sister agency or Ministry to understand the concerns and constraints.
